runner.note: The present runner reads exactly one of this suite's eleven files, accounting-v1-fixtures.json, through evals/fixtures/token-accounting-conformance.json and evals/fixtures/ranking-accounting.json. The other ten are executed by scripts/repository/validate_planning_artifacts.py, which proves schema conformance and reproduces the arithmetic in Python; that is one subject and not the two this manifest declares, so no case here may be cited as cross-language conformance.

cases.title: Accept the registered accounting profiles against the profile schema
Reproduce every Token Burn arithmetic vector byte-for-byte, including the profile digest
Refuse a quantity carried as a float rather than a decimal string
cases.note: D-193 declines to define float determinism and D-260 carries every quantity as an unsigned 64-bit integer in a decimal string. The refusal is a schema refusal; the reason code is the wire code the server emits for that class and is a mapping this manifest asserts rather than one the authority states.

cases.title: Resolve every deduplication vector to one counted observation
Refuse a deduplication preimage that is empty
cases.note: An empty preimage collides with every other empty preimage, so accepting it would deduplicate unrelated activity into one row.

cases.title: Capture the OTel datapoint series without inventing or dropping a counted attempt
Accept the certified producer bindings
cases.note: Every binding reachable from this repository is candidate, so this case proves the record is well formed and proves nothing about certified capture.

cases.title: Refuse a binding that claims competitive eligibility without an active certification
cases.note: D-388 pins any state other than active to a private-analytics ceiling.

cases.title: Apply the P-1140B accounting cases without double counting a contained category
Exclude imported activity and deduplicate a repeated observation across the nine ranking fixtures
cases.note: This is the only file in the suite any runner reads today.

cases.title: Reproduce every reconciliation vector under every ordering of its readings
cases.note: scripts/repository/validate_planning_artifacts.py evaluates each vector under every permutation of its readings and requires one result. A reconciliation whose total depends on which reading arrived first fails here.

cases.title: Refuse a reconciliation reading that records when it arrived
cases.note: The reading carries an arrival ordinal. accounting-arithmetic-v1.json forbids arrival-order as a tie-break input, and the vector schema refuses the field outright rather than admitting it and trusting nobody to read it: a field a vector can carry is a field a tie can be broken on. The refusal is a schema refusal; the reason code is the wire code the server emits for that class and is a mapping this manifest asserts.

note: The suite proves normalisation, token categories, retries and duplicates against the arithmetic record rather than against whichever implementation reads a profile first.
